name: YMCA Camp of Maine
description_short: Overnight YMCA camp founded in 1915 on the shores of Lake Cobbossee in Winthrop, Maine, offering one- and two-week sessions for boys and girls. Programs listed include Traditional Camp, Explorer's Camp and a LIT/CIT program.

refund_policy_summary: Balances are due June 1. The deposit ($125 a week, $250 a two-week session, per camper) is never refunded. Cancel more than 30 days before your session and you get 25% of the full tuition back; within 30 days there is no refund.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Lake Cobbossee. Certified lifeguards run the waterfront, which offers canoeing, kayaking, sailing, paddle boarding, snorkeling, water games and free swim. Younger cabins (Kennebec Porch and Cobbossee) are all assigned a period of swim lessons.
